level_one.title: Quarterback
level_one.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

level_four.title: The Bigger They Are...
level_four.description: Increase the damage bonus to 4% while enemy Heroes are above 30% Health, but Minigun no longer has any effect on targets below 30%.

level_seven.title: Melting Point
level_seven.description: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level_ten.title: Commandeer Odin
level_ten.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Neosteel Coating
level_thirteen.description: Activate to gain 75 Spell Armor for 4 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

level_sixteen.title: Titan Grenade
level_sixteen.description: Frag Grenade deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their maximum Health. Each enemy Hero hit by Frag Grenade reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

level_one.title: Hyper Shift
level_one.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 4% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 0.5 second.

level_four.title: Magic Spit
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Peekaboo!
level_seven.description: Phase Shifting to an ally grants both Brightwing and her target a 335 (+4% per level) Shield for 4 seconds and reveals a large area around them for 5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Blink Heal
level_ten.description: Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Safety Dust
level_thirteen.description: Increase Pixie Dust's duration by 1 second. Soothing Mist and Blink Heal heal allies with an active Pixie Dust for 75% more.

level_sixteen.title: Phase Out
level_sixteen.description: Activate to place Brightwing in Stasis for 0.75 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Speedy Dragon
level_twenty.description: Permanently gain 20% Movement Speed. Reduce Phase Shift's cast time by 1 second.

level_one.title: Mobile Offense
level_one.description: After moving, Fenix's next Basic Attack deals 35% more damage to Heroes.

level_four.title: Target Acquired
level_four.description: Basic Attacks against Slowed Heroes with Repeater Cannon active grant 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, up to 40%.

level_seven.title: Warp Warfare
level_seven.description: After arriving with Warp, gain 175% Attack Speed for 4 seconds while in Repeater Cannon mode. Hero Takedowns reset Warp's cooldown.

level_ten.title: Purification Salvo
level_ten.description: Channel for 1.5 seconds, sweeping a laser in front of Fenix that locks onto enemy Heroes. Once Channeling finishes, fire 5 missiles at each locked Hero, dealing 79 (+4% per level) damage each. Deals 50% increased damage to Slowed targets.

level_thirteen.title: Adanium Shell
level_thirteen.description: After arriving with Warp, gain 50 Armor for 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Offensive Cadence
level_sixteen.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against Heroes while Repeater Cannon is active deals an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health as damage.

level_one.title: Party Mix
level_one.description: Quest: Play Lúcio's Crossfade tracks to nearby allies. Multiple allies provide additional time.  Reward: For every 1 Minute played, permanently increase Lúcio's maximum Mana by 10.  Reward: Once you have played for 8 minutes or more, permanently increase Crossfade's radius by 20%.

level_four.title: Supersonic
level_four.description: While Wall Ride is active, Push Off's cooldown recharges 100% faster.

level_seven.title: Reverse Amp
level_seven.description: Blast Lúcio's active Crossfade track at enemy Heroes. While Amp It Up is active, Healing Boost deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second and Speed Boost Slows by 20%.  This ability is unaffected by Crossfade talents.

level_ten.title: Sound Barrier
level_ten.description: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: All Together
level_thirteen.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 5% Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.

level_sixteen.title: Rejuvenescência
level_sixteen.description: While Amp It Up is active, Crossfade's Healing Boost heals for an additional 2.5% of the target's maximum Health each second.

level_twenty.title: House Party
level_twenty.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 8% increased healing.

level_one.title: Echo of the Elements
level_one.description: Quest: Kill Minions or Heroes within 2 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning.  Reward: After killing 20 enemies, reduce the Mana cost of Chain Lightning from 40 to 20.  Reward: After killing 50 enemies, Chain Lightning gains an extra charge.  Mythic Reward: After killing 125 enemies, Chain Lightning can now strike the same target multiple times, and also strikes 1 additional target per bounce.

level_four.title: Mana Tide
level_four.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Follow Through
level_seven.description: After using an Ability, your next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 40% additional damage.

level_ten.title: Sundering
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 (+4% per level) damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

level_thirteen.title: Frostwolf's Grace
level_thirteen.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.

level_sixteen.title: Thunderstorm
level_sixteen.description: Chain Lightning Slows the primary target by 8% for 2 seconds when used on Heroes.  Quest: Targeting a Hero directly with Chain Lightning increases this Slow by 8%, up to an additional 40%.  Reward: While at a 40% bonus, Chain Lightning's damage is increased by 30%.  Bonuses are reset if Chain Lightning is used on the same Hero it was last used on, or if Thrall dies.

level_twenty.title: Wind Rush
level_twenty.description: Activate to immediately teleport to a target location and gain Windfury.
